input.title: Customer concentration can impair per-share compounding

materiality.rationale: A loss of the largest customer would materially reduce revenue and operating leverage.

causality.rationale: Customer loss transmits through revenue concentration into lower contribution profit and reinvestment capacity.

unresolvedness.rationale: Diversification evidence is insufficient to reduce the residual exposure below materiality.

input.overallRationale: The concentration risk has a material causal transmission mechanism and remains insufficiently mitigated.

input.title: Competition

materiality.rationale: Competitive pressure could be financially material if it occurred.

causality.rationale: No evidence-backed transmission mechanism from a specific competitive change to thesis damage has been established.

unresolvedness.rationale: Residual risk cannot be assessed because the causal mechanism is not established.

input.overallRationale: A generic risk label cannot qualify as a material weak link without an identifiable causal mechanism.

input.title: Maintenance capital intensity may be understated

materiality.rationale: A higher maintenance requirement could materially reduce owner cash.

causality.rationale: Higher maintenance capex directly lowers distributable owner cash and valuation support.

unresolvedness.rationale: Available disclosures do not separate maintenance and growth capex sufficiently.

input.overallRationale: Materiality and causality are supported but unresolvedness cannot yet be determined.

input.title: Refinancing concentration

materiality.rationale: A refinancing failure could materially impair per-share value.

causality.rationale: Refinancing failure would increase funding cost and constrain reinvestment.

unresolvedness.rationale: Committed liquidity and laddered maturities reduce the residual risk below materiality.

input.overallRationale: The mechanism is real but current mitigation resolves it below material weak-link status.
